scripts.build: node scripts/validate-planner-env.mjs production && node scripts/build-site.mjs && vite build --config vite.config.mts
scripts.lint: oxlint -D correctness -D suspicious --react-plugin --jsx-a11y-plugin --vitest-plugin --import-plugin -A react-in-jsx-scope -A no-named-as-default -A no-unassigned-import -A require-to-throw-message -A no-conditional-expect -A prefer-tag-over-role -A autocomplete-valid -A no-array-sort -A no-useless-fallback-in-spread -A set-state-in-effect -A no-noninteractive-tabindex -A no-noninteractive-element-interactions -A label-has-associated-control --deny-warnings planner-app/src tests scripts vite.config.mts playwright.config.mts
scripts.validate: npm run validate:legacy && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
